knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Project Overview

Clean up the following variables:

*  `Y`:  [int] sick-child visits by CSPS-month
*  `C1`: [dbl] rainfall (mm)     by month
*  `C2`: [bin] Ramadan           by month

### 0. Configure environment. Load data.
```{r config, show=F, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("analysis/0-config.R"))

############################
# Village id and names
############################
vill_id_name <- 
  read_csv(paste0(raw_data_path,"vill_codes_names.csv"))

############################
# CHAT household census data
############################
census <- 
  read_csv(paste0(raw_data_path,"CHAT_child_census_dataset.csv"))

############################
# CSPS geodata + visit data
############################
vill_csps_gps <- 
  read_csv(paste0(raw_data_path,"vill_csps_gps.csv"), 
           col_types = cols(csps = col_integer(), 
                            village = col_integer()))

############################
# CSPS surveillance data
############################
passive <- 
  read_csv(paste0(raw_data_path,"passive (1).csv"))

############################
# HDX rainfall data
############################
rain_data <- 
  read.csv(paste0(raw_data_path,"hdx_rainfall_data/bfa-rainfall-subnat-full.csv"),
           comment = "#")

```


### 1A. Clean village demographic data (name, `n_census`).
```{r village-dem-data, warning=F, message=F}

#################################
# Number of children per village
# Note: There are more villages 
# in vill_id_name (n=288)
# than in census (n=249)
#################################
vill_01A_pop <- 
  census %>% 
  distinct(childID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  group_by(village) %>%
  summarise(n_census=n()) %>%
  left_join(vill_id_name, by="village") %>% # Merge village names
  arrange(village) %>%
  relocate(commune, .after = "village")

#################################
# Save to temp data folder
#################################
write.csv(vill_01A_pop, paste0(temp_data_path,"vill_01A_pop.csv"))

```

### 1B. Clean wide data.
```{r clean-wide-data, warning=F, message=F}

#################################
# Create dx and date variables
#################################
visit_01A_labelled <- 
  passive %>%
  mutate(visit_date = as.Date(starttime),
         visit_year = year(starttime),
         visit_month = month(starttime),
         dx_type = case_when(diagnosis__57 == 1 ~ 1, #sev malaria
                             diagnosis__58 == 1 ~ 1, #non-sev malaria
                             diagnosis__39 == 1 ~ 2, #broncho-pneum
                             diagnosis__40 == 1 ~ 2, #low pneum
                             diagnosis__64 == 1 ~ 2, #pneum
                             diagnosis__21 == 1 ~ 3, #diarrhea
                             .default = 0)) 

#################################
# Merge CSPS and village dem data
#################################
visit_01A_merged <- 
  visit_01A_labelled %>%
  left_join(vill_01A_pop, by=join_by(village==village)) %>%
  mutate(inv_wt_vill_pop = 1/n_census) # visit wt by village pop size

#################################
# Exclude csps outside of Nouna
# and with missing csps ids
#################################
visit_01A_filtered <- #df_2
  visit_01A_merged %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("Outside Nouna",csps_name)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(csps_name))

#################################
# Generate aggregate monthly
# visit counts -- overall
#################################
visit_01A_all <- #df_3
  visit_01A_filtered  %>%
  group_by(csps,visit_year,visit_month) %>%
  summarise(n_visit = n()) # %>% dplyr::filter(!csps %in% c(28,50)) #%>% arrange(desc(n_visit_per100))

#################################
# Generate aggregate monthly
# visit counts -- by diagnosis
#################################
visit_01A_dx <- 
  visit_01A_filtered %>% 
  group_by(csps,visit_year,visit_month,dx_type) %>%
  summarise(n_visit = n()) # %>% dplyr::filter(!csps %in% c(28,50)) #%>% arrange(desc(n_visit_per100))

#################################
# Quick "sanity checks"
################################# 
length(unique(visit_01A_all$village)) #n=257 (7 more than in census df)
length(unique(vill_csps_gps$villcode)) #n=226 (31 fewer than in passive surveillance df)

```

### 1C. Create subsets of data.
```{r create-df-by-dx, warning=F, message=F}

#################################
# Create diagnosis-specific dfs
#################################
mal_01A_filtered <- visit_01A_dx %>% filter(dx_type == 1)
pne_01A_filtered <- visit_01A_dx %>% filter(dx_type == 2)
dia_01A_filtered <- visit_01A_dx %>% filter(dx_type == 3)

#################################
# Wide-to-long transformation + 
# add NAs for unobserved months
# (See 0-functions-processing.R
# for helper function details.)
#################################
all_01A_merged <- w2l_helper(visit_01A_all)
mal_01A_merged <- w2l_helper(mal_01A_filtered) 
pne_01A_merged <- w2l_helper(pne_01A_filtered)
dia_01A_merged <- w2l_helper(dia_01A_filtered)

#################################
# Create visit_date variable
#################################
# Overall
all_01A_mutated <- 
  all_01A_merged %>%
  mutate(visit_date = lubridate::make_date(visit_year, visit_month, 1)) %>%
  relocate(visit_date, .before = visit_year)

# Malaria
mal_01A_mutated <- 
  mal_01A_merged %>%
  mutate(visit_date = lubridate::make_date(visit_year, visit_month, 1)) %>%
  relocate(visit_date, .before = visit_year)

# Pneumonia
pne_01A_mutated <- 
  pne_01A_merged %>%
  mutate(visit_date = lubridate::make_date(visit_year, visit_month, 1)) %>%
  relocate(visit_date, .before = visit_year)

# Diarrhea
dia_01A_mutated <- 
  dia_01A_merged %>%
  mutate(visit_date = lubridate::make_date(visit_year, visit_month, 1)) %>%
  relocate(visit_date, .before = visit_year)

```

### 2. Create and merge offset variable, total observed visits per CSPS
```{r offset-var}

#################################
# Total visits by CSPS and village
#################################
visits_01A_cv_obs <- 
  passive %>%
  filter(csps > 0) %>%
  group_by(csps, village) %>%
  summarise(n_visits_observed = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(csps, village)

#################################
# Merge village census population
#################################
visits_01A_cv_merged <- 
  visits_01A_cv_obs %>%
  left_join(vill_01A_pop, by = "village")

#################################
# Max possible visits by CSPS
#################################
visits_01A_cv_max <- 
  visits_01A_cv_obs %>%
  group_by(csps) %>%
  summarise(n_visits_expected_max = sum(n_visits_observed, na.rm = TRUE))

#################################
# Total visits by CSPS
# (i.e., offset in the negative
# binomial regression models)
#################################
visits_01A_by_csps <- 
  passive %>%
  filter(csps > 0) %>%
  group_by(csps) %>%
  summarise(offset_tot_csps_visits = n()) %>%
  arrange(csps)

#################################
# Merge offset to main data
# (See 0-functions-processing.R
# for helper function details.)
#################################
all_01A_merged2 <- merge_offset(all_01A_mutated)
mal_01A_merged2 <- merge_offset(mal_01A_mutated) 
pne_01A_merged2 <- merge_offset(pne_01A_mutated)
dia_01A_merged2 <- merge_offset(dia_01A_mutated)

```

### 3. Clean and merge rainfall covariate data.
This is the 1-month aggregate amount of rainfall in PRIOR month to account for lagged effects of rainfall on disease transmission. Also created variable of CURRENT month, but not used in analyses.
```{r rainfall-var}

#################################
# Create actual + 1-month lag 
# date variables
#################################
rain_01A_mutated <- 
  rain_data %>%
  mutate(visit_date_lag = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
         visit_date = visit_date_lag %m-% months(1))

#################################
# Exclude rainfall data 
# prior to 2020,
# outside of study catchment area,
# and on 1st of the month

# n_pixels: number of input pixels 
#           to create aggregates 
#           (Kossi Province = 243)
# r1h: 1-mo rolling aggregation 
#      [in mm]
#################################
rain_01A_filtered <- 
  rain_01A_mutated %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(visit_date_lag) >= 2020, 
                PCODE == "BF4603",
                day(visit_date_lag) == 1) %>% 
  dplyr::select(visit_date_lag, visit_date, r1h)

#################################
# Merge rainfall to main data
#################################
# Overall
all_01A_merged3 <- 
  all_01A_merged2 %>% 
  left_join(rain_01A_filtered[,c(1,3)], 
            by = join_by(visit_date == visit_date_lag)) %>%
  left_join(rain_01A_filtered[,c(2,3)], 
            by = join_by(visit_date == visit_date)) %>%
  rename(r1h_lag = r1h.x,
         r1h_now = r1h.y)

# Malaria
mal_01A_merged3 <- 
  mal_01A_merged2 %>% 
  left_join(rain_01A_filtered[,c(1,3)], 
            by = join_by(visit_date == visit_date_lag)) %>%
  left_join(rain_01A_filtered[,c(2,3)], 
            by = join_by(visit_date == visit_date)) %>%
  rename(r1h_lag = r1h.x,
         r1h_now = r1h.y)

# Pneumonia
pne_01A_merged3 <- 
  pne_01A_merged2 %>% 
  left_join(rain_01A_filtered[,c(1,3)], 
            by = join_by(visit_date == visit_date_lag)) %>%
  left_join(rain_01A_filtered[,c(2,3)], 
            by = join_by(visit_date == visit_date)) %>%
  rename(r1h_lag = r1h.x,
         r1h_now = r1h.y)

# Diarrhea
dia_01A_merged3 <- 
  dia_01A_merged2 %>% 
  left_join(rain_01A_filtered[,c(1,3)], 
            by = join_by(visit_date == visit_date_lag)) %>%
  left_join(rain_01A_filtered[,c(2,3)], 
            by = join_by(visit_date == visit_date)) %>%
  rename(r1h_lag = r1h.x,
         r1h_now = r1h.y)

```

### 4. Create and merge Ramadan variable.
Updated November 2 2026: Now use exact dates of Ramadan, instead of months.
```{r ramadan}
#################################
# Ramadan dates (2020-2022)
# This helps determine whether 
# ramadan occurs for a sufficient
# number of days in a given mo.
# to assign ramadan==1
#################################
# 2020-04-24 to 2020-05-23
# 2021-04-13 to 2021-05-12
# 2022-04-02 to 2022-05-01

#################################
# Create + merge Ramadan var
#################################
all_01A_mutated2 <-
  all_01A_merged3 %>%
  mutate(ramadan = as.integer(
    (visit_year == 2020 & visit_month %in% c(5)) |
    (visit_year == 2021 & visit_month %in% c(4, 5)) |
    (visit_year == 2022 & visit_month %in% c(4))
  ))

mal_01A_mutated2 <-
  mal_01A_merged3 %>%
  mutate(ramadan = as.integer(
    (visit_year == 2020 & visit_month %in% c(4, 5)) |
    (visit_year == 2021 & visit_month %in% c(4, 5)) |
    (visit_year == 2022 & visit_month %in% c(4, 5))
  ))

pne_01A_mutated2 <-
  pne_01A_merged3 %>%
  mutate(ramadan = as.integer(
    (visit_year == 2020 & visit_month %in% c(4, 5)) |
    (visit_year == 2021 & visit_month %in% c(4, 5)) |
    (visit_year == 2022 & visit_month %in% c(4, 5))
  ))

dia_01A_mutated2 <-
  all_01A_merged3 %>%
  mutate(ramadan = as.integer(
    (visit_year == 2020 & visit_month %in% c(4, 5)) |
    (visit_year == 2021 & visit_month %in% c(4, 5)) |
    (visit_year == 2022 & visit_month %in% c(4, 5))
  ))

```


### 5. Save data.
```{r save-data}

write_csv(all_01A_mutated2, paste0(temp_data_path,"df_01A_all.csv"))
write_csv(mal_01A_mutated2, paste0(temp_data_path,"df_01A_mal.csv"))
write_csv(pne_01A_mutated2, paste0(temp_data_path,"df_01A_pne.csv"))
write_csv(dia_01A_mutated2, paste0(temp_data_path,"df_01A_dia.csv"))

View(all_01A_mutated2)

```
